learning_outcomes.text: Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning, and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Knowledge and capacities for the calculation, design, and testing of machines.
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, enabling them to learn new methods and theories, and providing them with versatility to adapt to new situations.
Structure discourse to facilitate understanding of the objectives, actions, and/or results of one's own work.
Develop professional texts or scientific-technical reports according to the conventions of the discipline.
Solve complex problems, autonomously, within the scope of the discipline.
Extract conclusions from practical or experimental work and research carried out autonomously.

syllabus_topics: Calculation of response for 1-DOF systems under free vibrations
Obtaining natural frequencies and vibration modes

assessment_methods.method: Resolution and co-evaluation of individual exercises and group problems

assessment_rules: It is an essential condition to obtain a minimum average score of 4 in the written tests to average with the exercises/reports/practices and with the Integrated Project. The final grade will be obtained by weighting the written tests by 70% and the practice/problem reports by 30%. The course will be considered passed provided that the final grade is equal to or greater than 5 points and that none of the grades for the parts is less than 4 points. Students will have 2 annual calls per subject and course to pass the written exam.
